wake.speaker: Nym
wake.text: Hey — breathe! The wreck is sinking and you're bleeding sand. Do you remember your name?

wake_ok.speaker: Insight
wake_ok.text: (SUCCESS) Ink fingers, scholar satchel, shaking hands. Scared FOR you. Trust her — for now.

wake_fail.speaker: Insight
wake_fail.text: (FAIL) Head pounds. Details blur. Just answer.

wake2.speaker: Kael
wake2.text: Enough. Tide takes the wreck by dusk and that Star still hums. Scholar — we leave the wounded and light the signal, or die curious.

c_nym.speaker: Nym
c_nym.text: Decency! Help me: bitter herbs for the sailor (east rocks), oil for the fire. Kael will pout. He'll live.

c_kael.speaker: Kael
c_kael.text: Soldier's answer. Bring oil from the wreck to the eastern pyre. The scholar's sailor may not last — war rarely asks.

c_peace_ok.speaker: Both
c_peace_ok.text: (SUCCESS) Stare... then nods. Kael: "A leader's answer." Nym: "Oh, I LIKE you."

c_peace_fail.speaker: Kael
c_peace_fail.text: (FAIL) Pretty words, no plan. Pick a side, stranger.

sailor.speaker: Wounded Sailor
sailor.text: Cold... the Star sang and the hull answered... Don't let them waste herbs on me — light the fire...

options.text: Give bitter herb (if you carry one).
"Kael's right. The fire matters more." Leave him.

sailor_healed.speaker: Nym
sailor_healed.text: Breathing steadies. You did that. The camp will hear of it — kindness is a kind of signal too.

sailor_stable.speaker: Kael
sailor_stable.text: Splinted. He'll live to the camp if the tide allows. Not every mercy costs the mission. Remember that.

sailor_left.speaker: Nym
sailor_left.text: ...I will remember you chose the fire over a man. So will he, if he wakes.

serren.speaker: Serren (Trader)
serren.text: Wreck-rats and wardens, my favorite customers. Gold for salvage, steel for sense. What'll it be?

options.text: [CUNNING DC10] "Warden prices for a warden's friend?"

serren_ok.speaker: Serren
serren_ok.text: (SUCCESS) Ha! Fine — 20 gold off your next kindness. Take it.

serren_fail.speaker: Serren
serren_fail.text: (FAIL) Nice try. Salt prices for salt tongues.

altar.speaker: The Pale Star
altar.text: *it hums your name* The chapel drowned praying to it. Light the great fire and call the fleet — or shatter the shard and silence it forever. Both have a price.

options.text: LIGHT IT — call the fleet home. (Kael's way)
SHATTER IT — no more songs, no more wrecks. (Nym fears this)
[WIT DC12] BIND IT — the Star knows you. (Nym trusts you)
[WIT DC12] BIND IT — you made peace once; do it again. (Peacemaker)

altar_bind.speaker: The Pale Star
altar_bind.text: (SUCCESS) The shard cools into your palm. It chose. The fleet will wait — and so will the deep.

altar_bind_fail.speaker: The Pale Star
altar_bind_fail.text: (FAIL) It burns. Choose, bearer — light or shatter, but choose.

banter_nym.speaker: Nym (campfire)
banter_nym.text: Do you think the Star sings, or only remembers singing? ...Thank you. For choosing people, back there.

banter_kael.speaker: Kael (campfire)
banter_kael.text: You held the line today. Exile or not — you drill like a warden. Tomorrow the chapel. Stay close.

campfire.speaker: Campfire
campfire.text: The fire pops. Rest restores all HP/MP (1 ration). Reflecting shapes the Sparks the Star left in you.

draft_tut.speaker: Nym
draft_tut.text: Your eyes - they glimmered, just now. The Star left Sparks in you. When you choose one, it shapes you: ember, iron or tide. Pick what feels true.

nym_bond2.speaker: Nym (campfire)
nym_bond2.text: Friend. If we stand together, I can call the Star down WITH you - look for Duo in battle. It costs us little, and them everything.

nym_bond4.speaker: Nym (campfire)
nym_bond4.text: Confidant. The duet burns hotter now - our Starfall sets the world alight. I trust you with the sky.

nym_bond5.speaker: Nym (campfire)
nym_bond5.text: Sworn. Whatever the Star wants of you, it goes through me first. Our duet is cheaper now - spend it freely.

kael_bond2.speaker: Kael (campfire)
kael_bond2.text: Friend. Shield to shield - call Phalanx Oath (Duo) and no line breaks us. I will hold; you strike.

kael_bond4.speaker: Kael (campfire)
kael_bond4.text: Confidant. The Oath hardens - we mend as we hold, and strike back harder. You fight like a warden born.

kael_bond5.speaker: Kael (campfire)
kael_bond5.text: Sworn. My shield is yours, my debt paid in advance. The Oath is cheaper now - use it every battle.

serren_star.speaker: Serren (Trader)
serren_star.text: Off the record? It didn't fall. It was aimed. Now buy something.

maren.speaker: Old Maren
maren.text: Salt in wounds, fever in tents. I need THREE bitter herbs, and the dunes only give to the patient. Help an old woman?

maren_rumor.speaker: Old Maren
maren_rumor.text: East rocks for herbs. And if you see a warden skulking the cove with no insignia — that's Joss. Tell him Maren still boils his bandages.

maren_done.speaker: Old Maren
maren_done.text: Brewed and bitter. Take this for the road — and the camp eats because of you tonight.

joss.speaker: Joss (deserter)
joss.text: Easy. Another warden-hunter? No — you'd have Kael's walk. What do you want with a dead man?

joss_ok.speaker: Insight
joss_ok.text: (SUCCESS) His eyes keep cutting to the wreck's split hull. The stash is there, not here.

options.text: "The hull stash. Split it with me."

joss_fail.speaker: Insight
joss_fail.text: (FAIL) Shuttered face. He'll say nothing — but he keeps what he keeps.

joss_cache.speaker: Joss (deserter)
joss_cache.text: Papers and pay-chest in the wreck hold. You take the gold, Kael gets his papers, nobody hangs. We never met.

per.speaker: Fisher Per
per.text: Crabs took my net AND my dinner. It's tangled by their tide-pools, west rocks. Fetch it and I'll split the catch.

per_done.speaker: Fisher Per
per_done.text: My net! And — psst — you didn't hear it from me, but smugglers work the cove east. Joss owes half the camp.

tess.speaker: Acolyte Tess
tess.text: The chapel keeps its dead AND its doors. The Warden within answers only to the old order. Do you know it, stranger?

tess_riddle.speaker: Acolyte Tess
tess_riddle.text: Sun wakes, Tide carries, Star keeps. Light the braziers SUN, then TIDE, then STAR — any other order gutters out.

tess_ok.speaker: Insight
tess_ok.text: (SUCCESS) Candle-grease under her nails, orchestrator's hands. She tends the braziers herself — and fears the Warden too.

tess_fail.speaker: Insight
tess_fail.text: (FAIL) Only incense and fear. She will not be hurried.

pilgrim.speaker: Pilgrim Vess
pilgrim.text: I came to pray and stayed to bleed. The Star below is not a god, friend. Gods don't need to be FED. Whatever you do at the altar — don't feed it.

pilgrim2.speaker: Pilgrim Vess
pilgrim2.text: Songs. Names. The Warden gave it his. That's why it wears his voice now. Remember my face, not its echo.

serren_ledger.speaker: Serren (Trader)
serren_ledger.text: My ledger? In the wreck hold, if your fingers itch. Read it and weep, friend — everyone on this coast owes someone.

ledger_ok.speaker: Serren (Trader)
ledger_ok.text: (SUCCESS) ...Forty. And you never saw the second page. Pleasure doing business with professionals.

ledger_fail.speaker: Serren (Trader)
ledger_fail.text: (FAIL) Cute. The price of my embarrassment just went UP. Buy something or walk.

ledger_open.speaker: Nym
ledger_open.text: Debts, bribes, a Warden's discharge bought and paid for... Serren, you're lucky the tide needs merchants. This goes to the campfire council.

plaque_sun.speaker: Sun Plaque
plaque_sun.text: "FIRST the Sun wakes the water, and thefleet sees the shore." — old tide-prayer, salt-worn.

plaque_tide.speaker: Tide Plaque
plaque_tide.text: "THEN the Tide carries the dead home, and asks no names." The letters below are dagger-scratched: pay the ferryman.

plaque_star.speaker: Star Plaque
plaque_star.text: "LAST the Star keeps what it catches. Do not sing back." Newer script, shaking hand: IT HUMS MY NAME.

plaque_deep.speaker: Drowned Plaque
plaque_deep.text: "WHAT SINGS BACK IS NOT THE STAR." The rest is barnacles.
